EC4RG-MF.NS.d: Sundaram AMC Ltd Emerging Small description is not available.

ELIN.NS.d: Elin Electronics Limited was established in 1969 and operates from New Delhi, India. It offers design and manufacturing solutions for domestic and international clients, with a portfolio that includes electric motors, tools, molds and dies, and consumer electronics such as lighting solutions.

GRAVISSHO.NS.d: Graviss Hospitality Limited operates in the hospitality industry. They are involved in owning and managing hotels, resorts, and restaurants, offering services related to accommodation, food and beverage, and event management. The company is located in Mumbai, India.

GSMFOILS.NS.d: GSM Foils Ltd. is an India-based packaging materials manufacturing company that specializes in producing blister foils and aluminum pharma foils. The company's primary products include plain, printed, coated, and poly-laminated foils, as well as strip foils, alu-alu foils, and lid foils, designed for high abrasion resistance, tensile strength, durability, bond strength, and superior sealing.

GTLINFRA.NS.d: GTL Infrastructure Limited, an independent and neutral telecom tower company, builds, owns, operates, and maintains shared passive telecom infrastructure sites. The company provides telecom towers on a shared basis to various telecom operators to host their active equipment; and delivers uninterrupted power on towers. It operates a portfolio of approximately 28,000 telecom towers across 22 telecom circles in India.

HBLPOWER.NS.d: HBL Power Systems Limited manufactures and sells batteries, power electronics, and spun concrete products in India and internationally. The company offers lead acid batteries, including pure lead tin VRLA, tubular gel VRLA, tubular plate vented, and flat plate VRLA batteries; nickel-cadmium batteries, such as pocket plate, sintered plate, and fiber plate batteries; and silver zinc aircraft, missile, torpedo, and reserve batteries.

HDFCLIFE-BL.NS.d: HDFC Life Insurance Company Limited is a life insurance provider in India offering a range of individual and group insurance solutions including protection, pension, savings, investment and health products. The company distributes its products through a multi-channel network of agents, brokers, and direct sales force and it is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

IBULLSLTD.NS.d: Indiabulls Limited and its associated entities run a digital platform business in India. Its social commerce app Yaarii lets users resell items including home decor, accessories, footwear and clothing. It also offers web development, real estate project advisory, and property construction and development.

INTELLECT.NS.d: Intellect Design Arena Limited provides software development and related services for banking, insurance, and other financial services in India and internationally.

KLL.NS.d: Kaushalya Logistics Ltd. is an integrated multi-modal logistics solution provider primarily serving the cement industry across India. The company offers a range of services including clearing and forwarding, primary and secondary transportation, raw material transportation, 3PL services, warehouse management, manpower services, and rake clearance.

KONTOR.NS.d: Kontor Space Ltd. operates in the professional services and real estate sector, providing managed office solutions and flexible workspace environments. The company's core business involves acquiring or leasing commercial properties and transforming them into fully serviced, plug-and-play office spaces. Its primary offerings include coworking spaces, managed offices, virtual offices, and meeting room rentals. Kontor Space Ltd.

KSOLVES.NS.d: Ksolves India Limited, based in Noida and established in 2012, provides software development, consultancy and related services to clients in North America, Europe, Australia, India and other markets, across a broad range of technology domains.

LCCPROJECT.NS.d: LCC Projects Limited is an Indian engineering, procurement and construction company. It builds dams, barrages, canals, irrigation and pipeline networks, water treatment and supply systems, metro rail, industrial buildings and roads, and also takes on mining, renewable energy and coal extraction projects.

LUMINO.NS.d: Lumino Industries Limited produces and sells electrical wires, power cables, conductors and related parts for the transmission and distribution of power, in India and abroad. Its products include aluminium conductors and low-voltage insulated power and control cables, aerial bunch, railway signalling, solar and fire-performance cables.

MAHESHWARI.NS.d: Maheshwari Logistics Limited provides logistics services in India. The company operates through three segments: Trading, Transportation & Port Service, and Manufacturing Kraft Paper. It offers bulk cargo transportation services for a range of sectors, including cement, paper, textiles, fertilizers, and other industries. The company also deals in coal, lignite, pet coke, diesel, waste paper, writing paper, kraft paper, and other papers; and manufactures recycled kraft papers.

MICEL.NS.d: MIC Electronics Limited engineers, produces and markets LED video display technology and various electronic and telecommunication equipment worldwide. Its products also include indoor and outdoor lighting, for instance industrial, parking and street luminaires, and street and home lighting powered by solar.

MITTAL.NS.d: Mittal Life Style Limited supplies bottom weight fabrics and denims in India. It offers fashion fabrics, cotton canvas denims, dupion bottom fabrics, polyester fabrics, cotton fabrics, knit fabrics, etc. to textile industry. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Mumbai, India.

MOHITE.NS.d: Mohite Industries Limited is an India-based company that is engaged in the business of textile manufacturing. It manufactures woven fabrics. The company is based in Maharashtra, India.

NEOGEN.NS.d: Neogen Chemicals Limited manufacturers and sells bromine and lithium based specialty chemicals in India. It offers organo bromine compounds, such as alkyl bromide compounds, dibromo alkane compounds, and bromo chloro alkanes; specialty chemical compounds; grignard reagents; advance intermediates; inorganic bromine compounds; and lithium salts. The company also provides custom synthesis and contract manufacturing services.

NILASPACES.NS.d: Nila Spaces Limited engages in the real estate development activities. It is involved in the construction and development of buildings for sale and other real estate activities. The company was formerly known as Parmananday Superstructure Limited and changed its name to Nila Spaces Limited in November 2017. Nila Spaces Limited was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

PODDARMENT.NS.d: Poddar Pigments Limited manufactures and sells color and additive masterbatches for dope dyeing of man-made fibers and various plastic applications in India. It offers manmade fiber products, such as polyester, polypropylene, and polyamide products; and plastic and packaging products that include additive masterbatches, film and packaging products, injection/blow/roto moldings, pipe extrusions, cables, pet performs and bottles, polyester films, and plastics smart products.

PRATHAM.NS.d: Pratham EPC Projects Ltd. is an integrated Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company in India. The company primarily serves the oil and gas sector, specializing in the end-to-end execution of pipeline projects, which includes design, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and maintenance of cross-country pipelines for natural gas and petroleum products, as well as city gas distribution (CGD) networks. Additionally, Pratham EPC Projects Ltd.

RAINBOW.NS.d: Rainbow Children's Medicare Limited is an Indian healthcare provider that runs multi-specialty hospitals focused on paediatrics, obstetrics and gynaecology. Its child health services include nutrition, nephrology, endocrinology, pulmonology, dentistry, psychology, oncology, haematology, gastroenterology, surgery, neonatology and general paediatrics.

RSL.NS.d: Rajputana Stainless Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker RSL and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SETCO.NS.d: Setco Automotive Limited manufactures and sells clutches for commercial vehicles in India and internationally. It offers clutch products and systems, pressure converters, and precision components. The company primarily offers its products under the LIPE and Lava Cast brand names. It serves commercial and military trucks, heavy-medium-light-duty trucks, marine, off highway, and agricultural equipment sectors.

SHREEPUSHK.NS.d: Shree Pushkar Chemicals & Fertilisers Limited engages in the manufacturing and trading of chemicals, dyes and dyes intermediate, cattle feeds, fertilizers, and soil conditioners in India.

SHRIRAMFIN.NS.d: Shriram Finance Limited is a non-banking finance company providing financing in India. Its products include fixed and recurring deposits, loans for commercial vehicles, tractors, farm equipment and construction equipment, personal, gold, used car and two-wheeler loans, green finance, and business loans including MSME and working capital loans.

SICAGEN.NS.d: Sicagen India Limited trades in and distributes building materials in India and internationally. It operates through Trading and Manufacturing segments. The company offers building materials, such as MS/GI pipes, precision tubes, structural tubes, seamless tubes, ERW tubes, rectangular/square hollow sections, steel fittings, PVC pipes, UPVC pipes, roofing sheets, electrical cables, switchgears, cement, etc., as well as construction steel, including TMT steel rebars.

SSDL.NS.d: Saraswati Saree Depot Limited, established in 1966 and based in Kolhapur, India, distributes traditional and ethnic women's clothing at wholesale. It sells sarees, kurtis, dress materials, blouse pieces, lehengas and related accessories. Customers are served online and through stores in Kolhapur and Ulhasnagar.

STARHEALTH.NS.d: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited sells health insurance in India. Its plans cover individuals, families, children, seniors and people with existing conditions, as well as employer and other groups including small and medium enterprises. It also offers personal accident and travel cover, a women's care policy and a product for children with autism.

STCINDIA.NS.d: The State Trading Corporation of India Ltd., together with its subsidiary STCL Limited, engages in the trading business worldwide. The company exports various products, including wheat, rice, tea, coffee, cashew, extractions, castor oil/seed, sugar, spices, jute goods, iron ore, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, light engineering goods, construction materials, consumer goods, processed foods, textiles, garments, jewelry, leather ware, etc.

SUVEN.NS.d: Suven Life Sciences Limited, a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, focuses on the acquisition, development, and commercialization of novel therapeutics for the treatment of neurodegenerative disorders in India, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It engages in drug discovery and development of new chemical entities (NCE) in central nervous system therapies.

TVSELECT.NS.d: TVS Electronics Limited, through its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, assembles, markets, sells, and services various transaction automation products in India and internationally. The company operates through Products & Solutions, Customer Support Services, and Fulfillment & Distribution Services segments.

UMIYA-MRO.NS.d: MRO-TEK Networks Limited manufactures, supplies and distributes access and networking equipment, in India and internationally. It has product, solution and real estate development segments. Offerings include modems, ethernet switches and routers, along with managed network and cloud services, and it also takes part in property construction and leasing.

VINCOFE.NS.d: Vintage Coffee & Beverages Ltd, with its subsidiaries, mainly makes, exports and sells coffee and other beverage products to Indian and international consumers, and also trades information technology goods. Established in 1980, it was known as Spaceage Products Limited until July 2021.

WEIZMANIND.NS.d: Weizmann Limited engages in the textile processing business in India. The company provides cotton voiles, pracales, and African prints. Weizmann Limited also exports its products primarily to Africa. The company was formerly known as Weizmann Industries Ltd and changed its name to Weizmann Limited in 1994. Weizmann Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India.

WSTCSTPAPR.NS.d: West Coast Paper Mills Limited produces and sells pulp, paper, and paper boards in India. It operates through two segments, Paper/Paperboard and Telecommunication Cables. The company provides printing and writing paper, machine-glazed paper and boards, security and hi-value grades paper, cup stock and coated duplex boards, and business stationery products, as well as premium printing paper under the WESCO brand.
